To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) we present a novel self training method (STM) for machine reading comprehension (2) STM can improve the performance of existing MRC models on multiple datasets (3) STM is effective for both extractive and non extractive MCR tasks (4) we provide an in-depth analysis on the effectiveness and efficiency of STM

a) a self training method can improve the MRC performance, b) the evidence labels are important for training the evidence extraction component, and c) the evidence extraction component is more difficult to train than the answer prediction component.
a self training method can significantly improve the performance of machine reading comprehension, and the method can be applied in a wide variety of MRC tasks.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following two questions: 1) How can we train a machine reading comprehension (or question answering) model with noisy supervision? 2) How to use the noisy supervision effectively?
how to improve the training of the evidence extractor in MRC with soft labels.
the following three questions: 1) Can we use the self training method to improve the performance of MRC models?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the self-training method works in machine reading comprehension.
our method is a promising approach to improve the MRC models.
the self training method can improve the performance of MRC models, especially in the non extractive setting.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we can achieve a new SOTA on three MRC tasks with only a single model trained on a small amount of data.
we present a self training method which can be easily applied on existing MRC methods to improve the performance.
we propose a novel method, Self Training, to improve the performance of MRC by using the pseudo evidence labels generated from the model itself.
The main takeaway from our work is that
self training with pseudo evidence labels is an effective approach to improve MRC models, especially when the golden evidence labels are not accessible.
, in the context of MRC, the evidence labels are a soft supervision signal and can be used to improve the model performance.
, in MRC, a self training method is a simple and effective way to leverage pseudo evidence labels to improve model performance.
